questions.prompt_en: Two maps describe a fictional coastal village in 2005 and 2025. In 2005, the village had a small harbour to the west, farmland in the centre, a school to the north and a road along the coast. By 2025, the harbour had been enlarged, the farmland replaced by housing, a park built beside the school and the coastal road extended eastwards. Summarise the changes. Write at least 150 words.
questions.prompt_vi: Use location language, past tenses and a clear overview; only describe supplied features.

answer.model_en:
The two maps show how a small coastal village changed between 2005 and 2025. They illustrate developments in housing, transport and public facilities over the twenty-year period.

Overall, the village became more developed. The harbour and road were expanded, farmland was replaced by homes, and a new park was added. However, the school remained in the same position.

In 2005, a small harbour was located in the western part of the village, while farmland occupied the central area. A school stood to the north, and a road ran along the coast. There were no housing developments or parks shown in the centre of the village at that time.

By 2025, the harbour had been enlarged, suggesting greater use of the waterfront. The most significant change was in the centre, where the farmland had been removed and a residential area constructed. In addition, a park had been built beside the existing school in the north. The coastal road had also been extended towards the east, although its original route remained visible.
